source.title: Same Answer, Different Confidence: Protocol Sensitivity in LLM Calibration
source.file: Same Answer, Different Confidence Protocol Sensitivity in LLM Confidence Calibration - 2605.27752v3.pdf

extraction_limitations: Atoms are source-grounded to the preprint and do not add external verification.
Reference-list citations were not atomized as independent evidence.
Per-setting values in large appendix tables were selectively atomized when they materially supported the paper’s main protocol-sensitivity claims rather than converted row-by-row into separate atoms.
No human reviewer verification has been recorded; review_status is extracted, not verified.
